mechanisms.decisive_claim: For every odd j>=33 in the actual K4,r9 family, the displayed rank-seven x and y tuples are legal canonical words and evaluate to the direct orbit states.
would_close: the exact canonical input required for the K4,r9 rank-seven recovery theorem
mechanisms.kill_test: Reconstruct direct rank-seven states and kill on the first binomial-sum mismatch, nondecreasing digit, or negative remainder.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Pascal cancellation of the stable K4,r9 rank-seven words gives gamma7=q^2-42q+26241900209700351953826.
would_close: the exact rank-seven surplus formula on the K4,r9 family
mechanisms.kill_test: Compare aligned cancellation, direct shadow evaluation, and exact integer values at the first stable q.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: All displayed K4,r9 rank-seven lower digits are canonical from the odd member j=33 onward and remain canonical under q_(j+2)=4q_j-4.

mechanisms.kill_test: Compute the strongest digit-order threshold and compare it exactly with q_33; kill if any displayed constant is too large.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Every odd j>=33 K4,r9 state has gamma5<0, gamma6<0, and gamma7>0.
would_close: a formal adaptive recovery theorem for the known double-negative counterfamily
mechanisms.kill_test: Certify the quadratic minimum/root position on the exact q progression and kill on any nonpositive member.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: For every fixed legal pair (k,r), each sufficiently late surplus gamma_m before recovery is an exact q-polynomial generated by a finite canonical transducer.
would_close: reduction of fixed-(k,r) adaptive recovery to polynomial sign analysis
mechanisms.kill_test: Enumerate fixed pairs and kill on endlessly new canonical offset states or nonpolynomial dependence after residue restriction.
mechanisms.status_evidence: The K4,r9 stable-tail theorem supplies one exact finite-state polynomial recurrence, but universality over all fixed (k,r) remains unproved.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Every fixed legal (k,r) actual dyadic family has a finite first eventual recovery rank bounded by an explicit function of k and r.
would_close: the fixed-parameter part of the adaptive (--)->(++) gap
mechanisms.kill_test: Search exact fixed pairs for increasing recovery ranks or a stable all-negative surplus sequence.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/K4_R9_NO_FIXED_RANK_RECOVERY.md: for fixed (k,r)=(4,9), for every R there is one actual odd member negative at every rank 3..R, so no finite bound depending only on k,r exists.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Once every affine digit dominates its lower constant in a fixed-(k,r) word, the next-rank constant recurrence preserves canonical ordering after an explicit q threshold.
would_close: inductive stability of displayed canonical words across ranks
mechanisms.kill_test: Generate constants exactly and kill at the first rank where a new lower constant overtakes its predecessor despite the threshold.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/K4_R9_NO_FIXED_RANK_RECOVERY.md proves the claimed induction mechanism on K4,r9; extension to arbitrary fixed (k,r) remains open.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: For every stable fixed-(k,r) transition, the first nonzero leading coefficient of the next surplus polynomial is positive by aligned Pascal cancellation.
would_close: eventual recovery after finitely many ranks for every stable fixed pair
mechanisms.kill_test: Symbolically enumerate stable transitions and kill on a zero or negative leading coefficient.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/K4_R9_NO_FIXED_RANK_RECOVERY.md and audit/K4_R9_RANK7_RANK8_CELL_SPLIT_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT.md: the stable surplus has leading coefficient -4 at every rank in the K4,r9 recurrence.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The K4,r9 rank-seven recovery mechanism persists on an explicit neighbourhood of fixed (k,r) residue families.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: There exists an actual fixed-(k,r) or slowly varying family whose canonical surplus stays negative through every finite rank allowed by the adaptive seed interface.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Every actual (--)->(++) state routes through finitely many canonical wall transitions to a proved positive-surplus leaf.

mechanisms.kill_test: Replay complete finite strips and fixed-parameter tails; kill on an actual unlabelled leaf or a cycle with negative surplus.
mechanisms.status_evidence: The K4,r9 theorem refutes bounded tree depth but does not refute finite parameter-dependent recovery for each state. A precise infinite locally finite tree claim is required before further testing.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Every local adaptive recovery certificate yields a legal persistent positive seed before rank 42 and composes to the public antichain construction.
would_close: the remaining global interface after local recovery
mechanisms.kill_test: Instantiate every index shift and legality hypothesis on the earliest and latest recovery ranks; kill on a missing persistence or suffix condition.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/K4_R9_NO_FIXED_RANK_RECOVERY.md with R=42 gives an actual family member with gamma3,...,gamma42 all negative, refuting any uniform pre-rank42 seed obtained by waiting along this orbit. This does not refute the public problem via other constructions.
